mlx.title: Model warming
mlx.descAlways: Keep the model loaded in memory at all times, until you quit Openstyle. Fastest repeat use, uses the most RAM.

mlxLlm.title: AI model warming
mlxLlm.descAlways: Keep the AI model loaded in memory at all times, until you quit Openstyle. Fastest repeat use, uses the most RAM.

mlxLlm.descMinutes: Keep the AI model loaded in memory for up to {{minutes}} minutes after each request. Faster repeat use, more RAM while warm.
